title: Listen — deadmanifesto

title: About Ginger Deadman
description: About Ginger Deadman: identity, artist background, biography and links across deadmanifesto.
text: Jack Aodh Ginger Kilbride Wolfe, they/them/theirs, Liverpool, UK, born 5 February 1998. Ginger Deadman is the artist behind deadmanifesto, working across experimental hip-hop, electronic music, visual work and games.

title: Bio — Ginger Deadman
description: Biography of Ginger Deadman, the artist behind deadmanifesto.
text: Ginger Deadman is an alias of Jack Wolfe, the artist behind deadmanifesto. They are a multimodal artist, working across experimental hip-hop, electronic music, visual work and games. The deadmanifesto catalog includes an archive of lyrics and mechanical productions from Ginger Deadman, functioning as an open distribution and streaming platform built on freeware with as much transparency as possible. Jack Wolfe works professionally as a QA Tester; all professional inquiries must relate to the Ginger Deadman / deadmanifesto projects.

title: The deadmanifesto — philosophy
description: The deadmanifesto: a working philosophy for building with AI rather than watching the AI era happen.
text: Version 1.1, 8 November 2026. AI-assisted versus AI-generated work, responsibility and attribution, individual capability, infrastructure and environment. Models used: Big Pickle, Gemini 4 Argon, Deepseek 4.1 flash, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Gemma 4, Beam Free, GPT 4o mini, GPT 6 Luna. Writing note: drafts are edited against Anbeeld's WRITING.md; the aim is clear, specific prose, not detector evasion.

title: Privacy — deadmanifesto
description: How deadmanifesto handles browser storage, hosting logs, search, RSS, external links and contact.
